title: ci(ui): start the Test UI shards when a package ui consumes changes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxHHSCmqGnGSksQmHYvbECcR)_
domain:devx#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BvP5Aq9USg5GtmgAAR
Fixes #28220

Ruling-ref: 6545651687 (letter A, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-31T15:50Z)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 只改了 lint、spec 等「ui 依赖的 7 个平台包」的 PR，现在合并前也会跑 ui 的 16 片单元测试(Test UI)。只改了根 `ci.yml`。
- **为什么改:** 以前这类 PR 只编译和打包 ui，不跑 ui 测试；坏了要等下一个无关 PR 进队列时才红，把别人踢出队列(#28219、#28491 等四次)。
- **风险与回滚:** 不影响产品代码。代价是 runner 分钟:每个这类合并约多 376 runner-min(PR 一次 + 队列一次，各约 188)。回滚 revert 这一个 PR 即可。
- **先看:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的 `test-ui` 的 `if:` 一行;其次 `test-ui-gate` 判「跳过是否合理」的那段 shell。
- **两分钟验证:** 合并后第一个只改 `packages/spec/**` 或 `packages/lint/**` 的 PR，检查列表里 `Test UI (k/16)` 显示 success 而不是 skipped。
- **需要你做的:** 这个 PR 改了 `.github/workflows/**`(Tier H)，需要你的批准，然后席位落地。

## What changes

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` only.

- **`test-ui` (`Test UI (n/16)`)** — the job-level `if:` now reads `needs.filter.outputs.ui != 'false' || needs.filter.outputs.ui_consumers != 'false'` (inside the existing `ui_tree` conjunct), the exact shape `ui-deps`, `type-check-ui` and `build-e2e-ui` already use. Which files run is unchanged: `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` already answers `mode=full` for any of the seven packages (`outsideTreeReasons`), so a `ui_consumers`-only diff runs the whole suite across the 16 shards.
- **`test-ui-gate` (the required `Test UI` context)** — its #4928 guard explains a `skipped` rollup only when `filter` succeeded and said `ui_tree=false`, or `ui=false` **and** `ui_consumers=false` (it read `ui` alone). This follows from the same `if:`: a skip is "expected" only on the diffs the shards' condition excludes. It also makes the gate the regression check for this card: if the `if:` ever drops `ui_consumers` again, the first `ui_consumers`-only diff reds `Test UI` instead of passing a silent skip.
- **`lint-ui` — not changed.** Measured below: ui's eslint reads none of the seven packages.
- Comments: the `filter` outputs block, the `ui_consumers:` list and a new "when the shards start" paragraph above `test-ui` say what starts the shards and why.

`scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` and `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` — **no edit needed, measured.** `check-expected-skips` derives its roster from each job's `if:` (`deriveGatedSkips`), so the row moves by itself: `--roster` printed `Test UI (${{ matrix.shard }}/16)  [ci.yml › test-ui; gate: job-gate filter ui_tree + filter ui; derived]` on `origin/main` `ea74ebf93` and prints `… gate: job-gate filter ui_tree + filter ui|ui_consumers; derived` on this head; its `--self-test` pins no live job name by design and passes unchanged. `check-ci-filter-parity` has no ui subject (it holds `core`/`crosspkg` to the cross-package declarations, Build Core's inputs and Test Core's turbo inputs); its scan and `--self-test` pass on this head.

## Why

A diff confined to `packages/lint/**` (or spec, client, core, formula, sdui-parser, types) compiled and built the Console against the new shape (Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI) but never started the ui tests that pin that shape. The red surfaced on the next unrelated PR that did start the shards, and that bystander was ejected from the queue: #28192 → #28197 (#28219), and PR #28467 → p0 #28491, the fourth recurrence.

## Tests

<details><summary>Reproduce first: the skip on origin/main ea74ebf93</summary>

Measured run — the queue build of #28192 (`3efccfd5`, `packages/lint/**` + `packages/metadata-protocol/**`), [run 41091107812](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41091107812), `merge_group`, read from the Actions jobs endpoint:

```text
Build UI Deps                      success
Type Check UI                      success
Build & E2E UI                     success
Live E2E UI                        success
Test UI (${{ matrix.shard }}/16)   skipped
Test UI                            success   (the aggregate read the skip as explained)
Lint UI                            skipped
```

Filter evaluation — the live `filter` job's `dorny/paths-filter` block read out of `ci.yml`, matched with picomatch 4.0.7 (the matcher `dorny/paths-filter` uses), then each ui job's job-level `if:` evaluated with those outputs on a `pull_request` event (a one-off scratch script, not committed):

```text
before (origin/main ea74ebf93)                     after (this head)
diff: packages/lint/src/index.ts                   diff: packages/lint/src/index.ts
filter outputs: ui=false ui_consumers=true         filter outputs: ui=false ui_consumers=true
Build UI Deps                STARTS                Build UI Deps                STARTS
Type Check UI                STARTS                Type Check UI                STARTS
Test UI (n/16)               SKIPPED               Test UI (n/16)               STARTS
Lint UI                      SKIPPED               Lint UI                      SKIPPED
Build & E2E UI               STARTS                Build & E2E UI               STARTS
Live E2E UI                  STARTS                Live E2E UI                  STARTS
```

`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` reads the same as lint on both sides; `ui/packages/core/src/index.ts` starts every ui job on both; `scripts/foo.mjs` starts none on both.

The selector already answers full for such a diff: `outsideTreeReasons({ outside: ['packages/lint/src/index.ts'] })` returns `packages/lint/src/index.ts: @objectstack/lint changed, and this tree's tests read its built output (through @object-ui/console)`, and over every tracked `packages/*/package.json` it turns full for exactly the seven `ui_consumers` packages (client, core, formula, lint, sdui-parser, spec, types).

</details>

<details><summary>The test-ui-gate verdict, every case</summary>

The gate's `run:` block read out of this head's `ci.yml` and executed with each input set (`OS_TEST_UI_RESULT OS_FILTER_RESULT OS_UI_TREE OS_UI OS_UI_CONSUMERS -> exit`):

```text
skipped success true  false false -> exit 0   no ui path, no consumed package: explained
skipped success true  false true  -> exit 1   a consumed package changed and the shards skipped: red (was exit 0)
skipped success true  true  false -> exit 1   unchanged
skipped success false true  true  -> exit 0   no ui tree: explained, unchanged
skipped failure true  false false -> exit 1   filter failed: red, unchanged
success success true  false true  -> exit 0   unchanged
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Lint UI: not added, measured.** `ui/eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project`/`projectService` (no type-aware rules, so no rule resolves a type from an `@objectstack/*` dist), and the two local rules that name `@objectstack/*` (`ui/eslint-rules/no-inline-spec-config.js`, `no-unprefixed-query-params.js`) match AST shapes and read no file. The ruling's condition ("only if ui's eslint reads those packages") is not met. Worth the seat's eye, not acted on here: other **Lint UI** steps do read the seven packages — `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` runs over spec's sources, and the skill-example / doc-snippet / doc-example / readme-export type checks compile against built `@object-ui/*` closures that include the `@objectstack/*` dists (`check:skill-examples --build-filter` derives 12 filters, `@object-ui/data-objectstack...` among them). So a spec change can still red Lint UI first on a bystander's ui PR. carrier: domain:devx seat (a card if the seat wants Lint UI on `ui_consumers` too, by the same one-line shape).
- **The same gap one step wider (noted, not filed).** The selector also turns full for every non-documentation workspace-root file and for `patches/**`; 21 such root files are tracked (`.npmrc`, `eslint.config.mjs`, `vitest.preset.mts`, `paseo.json`, `.gitattributes`, …) and several are not in the `ui:` list, nor is `patches/**`, so a diff confined to one of them still skips the shards. Not the ruling's scope; dedupe words: `ui filter patches npmrc Test UI skipped root file`. carrier: domain:devx seat.
- **No permanent pin added.** A select-affected-tests pin reconciling the `ui_consumers` list against the selector's package graph was drafted and dropped: it is the second, reconciling check the ruling declined with option B. The `test-ui-gate` change above is the in-surface regression check instead.
- Assignees: none set on this PR (the dispatch contract leaves the PR's assignee to the seat).

## Runner-minute cost (against #25869 and #25881)

- **Per full Test UI battery: ~188 runner-min.** Measured on the last four `push` runs of `main` (41258652854, 41261634108, 41261929545, 41262951436; 16/16 shards each): 185.2 to 192.1 runner-min summed, mean shard 11.6 to 12.0 min, slowest shard 13.6 to 14.4 min wall. A `ui_consumers`-only diff is always a full battery (the selector's `outsideTreeReasons`).
- **Per such merge: at least ~376 runner-min** — one PR-head run plus one queue entry; each extra push to the PR adds ~188. Build UI Deps already runs on these diffs, so the seven-package build #25869 de-duplicated is replayed from its cache and adds nothing.
- **How many: 220 of 1410 merges in the 7 days to 2026-11-01T02:00Z (15.6%)** touched one of the seven packages and no `ui:` path (first-parent `origin/main`, the live filter globs, picomatch); 22 of 138 in the last 24 h. At 22 to 31 a day that is ~8,300 to ~11,700 runner-min a day, lower bound.
- **Against #25881:** that card measured ~220 runner-min per queue entry for the four ui lanes and stopped paying it on entries that touch no ui path. This PR pays a part of it back (~188, Test UI alone) on the ~16% of entries that touch a package ui consumes — exactly the entries where it was skipped though its inputs changed. Entries touching neither stay skipped.
- **Wall clock:** not on the measured critical path. On run 41091107812 (lint-only queue entry) Build UI Deps finished by 16:37:32Z and Test Core's slowest shard ended at 16:54:40Z of a run that finished at 16:55:38Z; sixteen shards of at most 14.4 min, started when Build UI Deps ended, would have finished by about 16:52Z.

## Verification

Gate list derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this head (1 path vs merge base `ea74ebf93`): 53 derived, **53 run, 53 exit 0**; `--ran` reconciles `53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero: every row records its exit code). Run at head `33b9f44f31`, after a full `pnpm build` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (exit 0, 13m42s) for the four `dist/`-reading Build Core guards; `check:pm-dispatch-gates` ran its fast tier (1937 cases pass, 7 slow sections deferred). Beyond the derived list, the ui tests that read the root `ci.yml`'s ui jobs: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` on `select-affected-tests.test.ts`, `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`, `turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts`, `check-action-forward-parity.test.ts`, `lint-workflow.test.ts` — 5 files, 148 tests pass. `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --self-test`: 206 cases pass. Every CI family is the PR's own check-runs.
